verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents dedicated webhook types for Dispute (chargebacks), Payment events (funds added/deducted, i.e. clearing-like activity), Transfer, and Network token events, giving developers programmatic post-auth signals beyond the initial authorization webhook. However, the pack never uses the terms clearing/reversal/refund explicitly for card transactions, nor does it document a stable transaction identifier that ties auth-to-settlement events together for ledger reconciliation. missing for 10: explicit clearing/reversal webhook documentation, explicit refund-on-card-transaction webhook, and confirmation of a stable cross-event transaction ID for ledger matching.
